sloka: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने ।पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः ।। 5.56.3 ।।।।
transliteration: kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane ।paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste balodayaḥ ।। 5.56.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "O destroyer of foes, you are capable of rescuing me singlehanded. Your success will raise your strength and bring glory.
